name: @tern/client
description: The shared TypeScript client for the Tern engine: protocol types generated from crates/tern-ipc

scripts.generate: cargo run -q -p tern-ipc --bin tern-ipc-schema && node scripts/generate.mjs
scripts.check: cargo run -q -p tern-ipc --bin tern-ipc-schema -- --check && node scripts/generate.mjs --check
